• **vunderba**：将Gemini 2.0与OpenAI 4o、Midjourney 7、Flux等顶尖图像生成模型进行了对比，认为Gemini 2.0在美学质量上不如Google之前的Imagen 3.0。不过，Gemini 2.0在多模态支持和生成速度上优于OpenAI 4o。
• **eminence32**：对使用对话界面进行图像生成的效果表示怀疑，认为描述复杂图像的词汇有限，调整生成结果的过程较为困难，可能需要更多的想象力。
• **simonw**：指出使用Gemini 2.0生成图像的成本较高，41MB的JSON包含28张图片，成本超过1美元，并提供了一个工具来渲染生成的JSON数据。
• **Tsarp**：认为直接测试和结合工具（如controlnets）测试的结果可能会有很大差异，开放模型如Flux通过适当工具可以生成更高质量的图像。
• **mkl**：对Gemini 2.0在生成图像细节上的表现提出质疑，认为在处理复杂指令时结果不如预期。
• **cush**：对Gemini的涂鸦演示感到有趣，并分享了相关链接。
• **emporas**：分享了使用Gemini生成专辑封面的复杂工作流程，结合了其他LLM模型以优化结果。
• **Yiling-J**：展示了使用Gemini 2.0生成100个食谱及其图像的成果，认为结果良好，并分享了开源项目链接。
• **minimaxir**：指出Gemini 2.0每张图片的定价为0.039美元，高于Imagen 3的0.03美元，并讨论了Gemini 2.0在对话生成图像上的优势和Imagen 3在图像质量上的可能优势。
• **mNovak**：对Gemini 2.0的共同绘图演示结果不一，特别是在理解火柴人图示方面存在问题。
• **thornewolf**：认为Gemini 2.0的输出结果不错，但仍有较多失败情况，期待更多已知良好工作流的展示。
• **pentagrama**：反思Gemini 2.0的应用可能指向电商和购物场景，担心AI生成内容泛滥对人类工艺和真实物品的冲击。
• **egamirorrim**：对如何使用Gemini 2.0编辑照片感到困惑，尝试修改图片但结果与原图差异较大。
• **qq99**：质疑Gemini 2.0的新功能是否已经在AI Studio中提供，并认为新版本的改进难以追踪。

补充讨论：
• **成本与定价**：simonw和minimaxir提到了Gemini 2.0的使用成本较高，并与Imagen 3进行了对比。
• **生成图像的质量与细节处理**：vunderba、mkl和mNovak对Gemini 2.0在处理复杂指令和生成高质量图像上的表现提出了质疑。
• **应用场景与潜在影响**：emporas和pentagrama讨论了Gemini 2.0在专辑封面制作和电商场景中的应用，并反思了AI生成内容对人类工艺的潜在影响。
• **工具与工作流**：Tsarp和emporas分享了结合其他工具和LLM模型优化图像生成结果的经验。

争议焦点：
• Gemini 2.0在图像生成质量、成本和应用场景上的表现和价值存在争议，部分用户认为其生成质量和细节处理不如其他模型，而部分用户则对其多模态支持和速度表示赞赏。

data.title: Telling Lies: Bowie and Online Music Distribution in 1996
data.author: herbertl
data.article_summary: 1996年，尽管在线音乐零售通过网站如Music Boulevard和CDnow蓬勃发展，但音乐下载和流媒体仍面临挑战。大卫·鲍伊（David Bowie）在当年9月通过其网站提供单曲《Telling Lies》的免费下载，成为在线音乐分发的早期试验。N2K公司试图通过互联网直接分发音乐，绕过唱片公司。然而，由于当时带宽有限，音乐文件下载困难且质量较低。尽管提供了多种格式，包括通过Liquid Audio提供的CD质量文件，下载时间长且需要专用软件播放。此次尝试展示了互联网对音乐分发模式的潜在影响，但技术限制使其难以实现理想效果。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：音乐行业的技术变革与早期在线音乐发行

不同观点：
• burningChrome认为Prince是音乐行业变革的先驱，他预见了单曲发行在未来的主导地位，但由于技术限制，他的理念当时未能完全实现。Prince希望根据自己的节奏发布音乐，而不是遵循传统的专辑发行模式。burningChrome还指出，苹果公司之后的iTunes通过单曲销售音乐，验证了Prince的预见。
• dhosek补充说明了1999年Napster的兴起对音乐发行的影响，并提到当时数字音乐文件的播放设备和音质都很差，直到iPod的出现才有所改善。dhosek还通过个人经历描述了在数字音乐普及前，音乐分享和播放的方式。
• buildsjets指出Aerosmith在1994年通过Compuserve发布单曲"Head First"是更早的在线音乐发行实例，早于David Bowie和其他音乐人。
• zirkonit认为David Bowie是互联网领域的先锋，包括在1994年拥有个人网站、1997年首次直播演唱会等。
• ChrisMarshallNY提到了Hilary Rosen与Larry Rosen的关系，并隐含了对Napster时期音乐版权争议的讨论。
• LaundroMat解释了专辑存在的经济原因，即在实体发行时代，生产和运输单曲的成本更高。
• bdcravens描述了1997-1998年间在486电脑上播放MP3的困难，需要在DOS环境下进行，且无法进行其他操作。
• neilv回忆了David Bowie在CompuServe上的在线聊天活动，并将其与当今社交媒体管理员的活动进行类比。
• Animats对文章未深入探讨电子商务实施细节表示不满。
• fallinditch提到David Bowie的鼓打贝斯阶段，并指出他是首个将个人音乐目录出售给投资工具的艺术家。
• bitwize讨论了早期音乐盗版对合法音乐发行网络的影响，并指出盗版网络对音乐分发的塑造作用。bitwize还提到音乐DRM问题在不同媒体类型中的差异。
• dirtyhippiefree批评了RIAA（美国唱片业协会）起诉粉丝的行为，认为这是不明智的商业策略。
• helpfulContrib描述了1996年创建的音乐人线上服务，该服务促进了跨洲的音乐文件分享和社区互动，并最终发展成线下活动。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到早期在线音乐发行的实例，如Aerosmith和David Bowie，以及这些实例对后来音乐行业的影响。
• 讨论涉及了技术限制、音乐分享方式的变化、盗版问题和DRM等多个与在线音乐发行相关的主题。
• 争议的焦点之一是音乐行业的商业策略和版权保护问题，尤其是RIAA起诉粉丝的行为引发的批评。
• 另一个讨论焦点是技术进步对音乐发行和消费方式的深远影响。

43917376.article_content:
Telling Lies: Bowie and Online Music Distribution in 1996
Online music retail was thriving by 1996, thanks to sites like Music Boulevard and CDnow. But music downloads and streaming was more of a challenge — as David Bowie discovered in September 1996.
By
Richard MacManus
|
May 7, 2025
| Tags:
Dot-com
,
1996
The CD version of David Bowie's online single, 'Telling Lies', 1996;
via kupindo.com
.
In an interview featured in the 1998 book “The Interactive Music Handbook,” Larry Rosen — CEO of an online music services company called N2K — provided his theory on how the internet would overhaul the music distribution system.
“The model that’s eventually going to prevail is one where the artist is going to finance her own record, produce it, and divide the distribution rights up.”
After explaining that the artist will no longer need to be signed to a record company for multiple years, Rosen said she would instead “go to a company like N2K and have us distribute the record electronically, or to all the people you have online in those particular areas, and we’re going to receive “X” percentage of these sales.”
So that was the goal of
David Bowie’s digital partner, N2K
: to distribute an artist’s music online and cut out the middlemen, a.k.a. the record labels. After all, the primary task of a record label was to distribute music, so surely they would no longer be needed when the internet matured?
David Bowie's website, October 1996;
via Wayback Machine
.
By 1996, the
retail part of online music existed
, but not the electronic distribution part. At that time, buying music online meant purchasing a CD — or some other physical format provided by a record label — on a retail website like Music Boulevard (owned by N2K) or CDnow (its arch-rival).
Although the pioneering
Internet Underground Music Archive
had proven that downloading music as a digital file was possible, the low bandwidth of the era made it hugely impractical. But Rosen thought that, eventually, records would be able to be “electronically transmitted” over the internet — “you would take those sounds and convert them into bits and send them to somebody on the other end, on a global basis, and they would store it.”
CDnow website, October 1996;
via Wayback Machine
.
(Incidentally, IUMA co-founder
Rob Lord became
“the new Vice President of Rock Sites for N2K Entertainment” at around the same time N2K acquired Rocktropolis.)
Telling Lies
The first test of this theory with a major music artist was, naturally, David Bowie. In September 1996, Bowie’s latest single “Telling Lies” was made available as a free download on the N2K-produced website, davidbowie.com.
Bowie's 'Telling Lies' single on his website, circa September 1996;
via Wayback Machine
.
The song was uploaded to the site on 11 September, 1996, and two remixes followed later. MP3 wasn’t an established online music file format at the time, but fans could access the song in eight other formats, according to
a later New York Times report
. The easiest option was to stream the song on the site, using RealAudio or Shockwave audio. These were low quality files, to try and minimise buffering.
There were also mpeg versions available, probably MP2, although these too were relatively low quality. One user on the Bowie newsgroup reported three mpeg versions (5Mb, 3.8Mb and 1.3Mb). Another said she tried to download the 5MB version using AOL “and the download quit after about 2 hours and gave me only about 4.2 MB.” She was able to listen to “about 4 1/2 minutes of the song from this incomplete file,” but
noted that
“the sound quality seems pretty bad.”
The different versions of Bowie's 'Telling Lies' single;
via Wayback Machine
.
If you wanted higher quality, you could download a 16-bit CD-quality file that “took 45 minutes to grab with a 28.8 Kbps modem” (according to the Times). This was provided by Liquid Audio, a new company founded earlier that year by Gerry Kearby, a native of Redwood City, California. Kearby, who had
previously worked
as an audio technician for bands like The Grateful Dead and Jefferson Airplane, wanted to create an online distribution technology that included copyright protection features. To achieve this, the company
partnered with Dolby Labs
for the compression technology and
added its own
watermarking and digital signatures.
The Liquid Audio version of “Telling Lies” was a
9.7MB zip file
, which opened to reveal a 9.9MB .la1 file (which
stood for
“Liquid Audio File”). That zip file would have taken at least 45 minutes to download over a 28.8 Kbps modem — but probably more than that, given how variable bandwidth was over dial-up. The user would then have needed the Liquid Audio player software to play the song.
N2K's e_mod website, where people could download Liquid Audio File music.
Some users reported not being able to access the site at all. “Maybe the site is just too busy or something, but all I've been getting are server errors and the like,” wrote one disappointed fan
on alt.fan.davi

data.title: Mistral ships Le Chat – enterprise AI assistant that can run on prem
data.author: _lateralus_
data.article_summary: Mistral AI推出Le Chat Enterprise，这是一款功能丰富的AI助手，基于全新的Mistral Medium 3模型，旨在解决企业AI面临的工具分散、知识整合不安全、模型僵化以及投资回报慢等挑战。Le Chat Enterprise提供统一的AI平台，包括企业搜索、代理构建器、自定义数据和工具连接器、文档库、自定义模型和混合部署等功能。该平台注重隐私保护，支持自托管和云部署，具有高度可定制性和控制力，并提供全面的审计日志和存储功能。企业可以通过Le Chat连接到Google Drive、Sharepoint等多个系统，快速获取个性化答案，并利用AI自动化常规任务。Le Chat Enterprise现已在Google Cloud Marketplace上线，并将陆续登陆Azure AI和AWS Bedrock。用户可通过chat.mistral.ai体验或下载移动应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Mistral的成就及其在AI领域的表现，以及相关技术细节和争议

不同观点：
• beernet认为Mistral实现了其他被过度炒作的欧盟AI初创公司未能实现的成就，并对此表示赞赏。
• codingbot3000强调Mistral在数据隐私方面的优势，特别是可以在Mac上的Docker中本地运行。
• qwertox对Mistral的速度表示赞赏，认为比Gemini和ChatGPT快很多。
• Havoc对Mistral的定位感到困惑，不确定它是一个API、企业部署的模型，还是软件加本地模型的组合。
• 85392_school提到Mistral Medium 3的发布，并提供了相关讨论链接。
• _pdp_认为多样化的模型选择是关键，不同模型适用于不同任务。
• I_am_tiberius表示更信任Mistral的数据处理方式，相比OpenAI更有安全感。
• victorbjorklund质疑为何要使用Mistral而不是开源模型。
• mxmilkiib指出网站在黑暗模式下显示有问题。
• amelius对Mistral如何保护其知识产权表示好奇。
• starik36关注本地部署的硬件要求，如GPU和磁盘空间。
• badmonster对其他LLM竞争对手是否会采取相同策略表示好奇。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及Mistral的技术实现、隐私保护、市场竞争等多个方面。
• 争议的焦点在于Mistral的具体定位和优势，尤其是与开源模型的比较以及硬件要求的不明确。
• 用户对Mistral的速度和数据隐私保护给予了积极评价，但也存在对其技术细节和实际应用中的小问题的关注。

通过这些观点，可以看出Mistral在技术社区中引起了广泛讨论，涉及其市场定位、技术优势及潜在挑战。

data.title: Show HN: 100.st – Dev utilities I built for format conversions and encoding
data.author: abdelbkk
data.article_summary: 100.st 是一个多功能开发者工具集，旨在提升工作效率。它提供各种格式转换工具，如 JSON、YAML、XML、CSV 之间的互转，以及 UUID 生成工具（NIL, V1, V4, V7）。此外，还包括大小写转换（camelCase, kebab-case, snake_case 等）、文本编码工具（Text to Hex, ASCII to Text）、网络工具（生成 IPv4, IPv6, Mac 地址）和文本处理工具（删除空行、添加前后缀等）。该平台涵盖了开发者常用的多种实用功能，简化了日常操作。

data.title: Stringly Typed
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了软件开发中的一个新术语——“stringly typed”，指在有更好类型选择的情况下仍使用字符串进行数据传递。这种模式常见于API调用中，因为请求和响应体通常是字符串化的JSON数据。作者以JavaScript为例，说明由于其弱类型特性，开发者常忽视类型安全。然而，作者认为如果将API端点视为远程函数调用，并期望在前端应用中实现类型安全，那么“stringly typed”会带来类型丢失的问题，特别是在使用TypeScript等强类型语言时。尽管有一些解决方案如tRPC或GraphQL，作者仍希望在整个网络传输过程中实现类型安全，并对今后可能频繁遇到“stringly typed”接口感到困扰。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于“网络数据类型安全”及数据序列化格式的不同观点和讨论

不同观点：
• cartoffal认为，“网络上的类型安全”是一个虚构概念。无论使用何种语言，数据最终都会以二进制形式传输，并在某个层面被解析为特定格式。他指出，数据解析过程不可避免，与语言无关，JSON作为数据序列化格式并不优于其他格式。
• bqmjjx0kac认为该评论内容空泛，仅是重新定义了“stringly typed”概念，并强调应使用合适的类型。
• zzo38computer指出，JSON被过度使用，DER可能是更好的选择。他还提到，在强类型语言中，可以通过错误处理来解析和使用预期数据类型，而无需手动检查类型。
• titter反驳了“JavaScript是弱类型语言，缺乏类型安全”的观点，指出JavaScript是动态类型语言，具有强类型信息，但数值类型标签会被优化。
• t-writescode表示强烈依赖类型，并在数据进出系统时进行类型检查和错误处理，认为这样更安全。
• somat提到OpenBSD在其pledge API中使用了“stringly typed”系统，认为这是为了简化使用，但作为C程序员，这种接口设计显得奇怪。
• teo_zero举例说明C语言中fopen()函数需要传递“r+”参数是“stringly typed”的一种表现。
• TeaVMFan赞赏Flavour框架的强类型Web服务调用，认为这使得代码更简洁，并由框架处理JSON的编组和解组。
• valorzard质疑JSON作为标准序列化格式的优越性，询问是否有更好的选择。
• Ciantic引用Anders Hejlsberg对JavaScript“stringly typed”的批评，指出这在API设计中不被欢迎。
• dleeftink推荐Structurae的二进制协议，认为其提供了从端到端的类型安全。
• GauntletWizard认为使用JSON的API并不一定是“stringly typed”，缺乏JSON验证的API才是。他强调了使用序列化库的重要性，并回顾了游戏保存文件从内存转储到标准序列化库的发展历程，指出现代序列化库在安全性和效率上的妥协。
• lock1认为在结构类型系统的语言中无法避免“stringly typed”和其他混乱问题。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及多种序列化格式（如JSON、DER）和协议（如Structurae的二进制协议）的优缺点。
• 强调了强类型语言和序列化库在处理数据类型安全和防止恶意数据方面的重要性。
• 争议的焦点在于“网络上的类型安全”是否是一个实际可达成的目标，以及JSON作为序列化格式的优劣。

43887489.article_content:
Stringly Typed
Written by
Stefan Judis
Published at
May 03 2025
Updated at
May 04 2025
Reading time
2min
I learned a new software development term from Scott Hanselman:
"stringly typed"
.
Scott describes "stringly typed" as follows:
[whenever] you are passing strings around when a better type exists.
An application is "stringly typed" when type information is available, yet you're calling other systems or functions based on strings or stringified data. Unsurprisingly, most API calls are "stringly typed" because request and response bodies are often stringified JSON data.
const
response
=
await
fetch
(
"https://example.org/subscribe"
,
{
method
:
"POST"
,
body
:
JSON
.
stringify
(
{
username
:
"..."
,
password
:
"..."
}
)
,
}
)
;
const
user
=
await
response
.
json
(
)
;
JavaScript is a weakly typed language without much type safety, so the type loss wasn't a big deal for me so far. And because most APIs speak JSON, the possible types are limited to strings, numbers, objects, arrays, booleans and
null
anyway.
We've all gotten used to this state of affairs, haven't we?
Let's flip things around for a moment:
what if we considered API endpoints to be remote function calls?
what if we considered API endpoints to be part of the frontend applications instead of remote interfaces?
The API call above could be seen as a
subscribe
function with a
username
and
password
parameter that returns a
user
object.
If you're using a strongly typed language like TypeScript, receiving the
user
object as
any
or
unknown
type is unfortunate. You'll lose all the type safety and you can only regain it with manual type checking. "Stringly typed" types in a type-safe environment suck.
After building all these SPAs connecting to APIs being maintained by different teams, I've never considered it to be a huge problem, but now that I have a name for this pattern, "stringly typed" interfaces started to bother me.
I realize that I want type safety over the network and I don't want to deal with "stringly typed" apps at all. I want all the types!
Of course, the problem of "stringly typed applications" isn't new and there are JS solutions like
tRPC
or typed API interfaces like GraphQL out there. I played with GraphQL quite a bit but will explore type safety over the wire now.
However, I wonder if I had just had a TypeScript epiphany and will start to discover (and curse) "stringly typed" interfaces everywhere, just because I now have a name for it.

data.title: OpenSearch 3.0 Released
data.author: kmaliszewski
data.article_summary: OpenSearch 3.0发布，性能大幅提升，相较1.3版本提升9.5倍，并比主要竞争对手快1.6倍。该版本专注于解决AI应用中大规模矢量数据处理的速度、成本和扩展性问题，支持生成式AI、混合搜索、检索增强生成（RAG）等功能。新特性包括GPU加速矢量引擎，提升性能并降低成本达3.75倍；支持模型上下文协议（MCP），增强AI代理通信能力；以及通过“派生源”功能减少存储消耗。此外，增强的数据管理功能如gRPC支持、拉取式数据摄入和读写分离优化了资源使用和扩展性。核心升级包括Lucene 10和Java 21的支持，确保平台未来创新和效率。OpenSearch 3.0旨在为社区提供开放、可扩展的搜索和分析平台。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenSearch项目的现状及其与Elasticsearch的竞争

不同观点：
• [wqtz] 认为 OpenSearch 是一个因Elasticsearch更改许可协议而产生的应对项目，主要是由AWS主导，带有一定的对立情绪。该用户指出OpenSearch社区不活跃，缺乏企业用户，且在SIEM（安全信息和事件管理）领域难以替代Elasticsearch。此外，他们认为Elasticsearch在开放源代码方面的姿态变化使得OpenSearch的存在价值受到质疑，企业不太可能为一个未经测试且没有长期承诺的项目进行迁移。

• [simple10] 对OpenSearch的基本情况进行询问，表现出对OpenSearch作为Elasticsearch替代品的兴趣，特别是其作为Elasticsearch的fork，是否仍然可以作为直接替代品以及其性能和功能的对比。

• [aabhay] 关注OpenSearch在机器学习领域的knn（k近邻）和向量计算能力，并对其在大规模应用中的表现表示担忧，尤其是在实际操作中可能出现的问题。

• [unethical_ban] 强调了在使用OpenSearch或ELK（Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana）进行简单日志摄入时的复杂性，表达了对设置过程的不满，认为这影响了工具的易用性。

补充讨论：
• OpenSearch的社区活力和企业接受度是讨论中的一个焦点，[wqtz]认为社区不够活跃且缺乏企业用户，而[simple10]则在探索其作为替代品的可行性。
• OpenSearch的技术能力和性能，尤其是其在机器学习和日志处理方面的表现，是另一个讨论要点，[aabhay]和[unethical_ban]分别从不同角度提出了实际应用中的挑战和困难。
• 许可协议和项目动机也被提及，[wqtz]指出OpenSearch的产生背景和Elasticsearch在开放源代码方面的策略变化，引发了对项目长期生存能力的质疑。

争议焦点：
• OpenSearch是否能作为Elasticsearch的可行替代品，尤其是在企业环境中的应用和长期支持方面。
• OpenSearch在技术性能和易用性方面的实际表现，尤其是在大规模应用和特定功能（如knn和向量计算）上的有效性。

Latest iteration bolsters open, scalable, community-driven search and analytics, enabling sustainable innovation
SAN FRANCISCO – May 6, 2025 –
The
OpenSearch Software Foundation
, the vendor-neutral home for the OpenSearch Project, today announced the general availability of OpenSearch 3.0. This major release delivers a 9.5x performance improvement over OpenSearch 1.3, building on
benchmarking data
that showed earlier iterations of OpenSearch operating 1.6x faster than its closest industry competitor.
Today’s AI applications — like generative AI, hybrid search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and recommendation engines — rely heavily on vector databases to find patterns in massive, complex datasets, but as the number of vectors explodes into the billions, many organizations struggle with speed, spend and scalability.
Forrester
emphasizes that traditional databases are no longer able to meet the growing demands of generative AI due to limitations in supporting modern vector multidimensional data and performing similarity searches.
OpenSearch 3.0 addresses this challenge and enables users to increase efficiency, deliver superior performance, and accelerate AI application development via new data management, AI agent, and vector search capabilities. Simultaneously, enhancements such as GPU-supported capabilities can reduce costs by 3.75x.
“The enterprise search market is skyrocketing in tandem with the acceleration of AI, and it is projected to reach $8.9 billion by 2030,” said Carl Meadows, Governing Board Chair at the OpenSearch Software Foundation and Director of Product Management at Amazon Web Services (AWS). “OpenSearch 3.0 is a powerful step forward in our mission to support the community with an open, scalable platform built for the future of search and analytics, and it reflects our commitment to open collaboration and innovation that drives real-world impact.”
Vector engine innovations increase processing speed and efficiency
To support its large-scale search platform and manage a vast amount of vector data, OpenSearch introduced GPU-based acceleration,
leveraging NVIDIA cuVS
for indexing workflows. New
vector engine
features include:
GPU Acceleration for OpenSearch Vector Engine:
Delivers superior performance for large-scale vector workloads while significantly lowering operational spend by reducing index building time. By enabling GPU deployment, this experimental feature heightens performance for data-intensive workloads and accelerates index builds by up to 9.3x.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) Support:
Native MCP support allows AI agents to easily communicate with OpenSearch, enabling more comprehensive and customizable AI-powered solutions.
Derived Source:
Reduces storage consumption by one-third by removing redundant vector data sources and utilizing primary data to recreate source documents as needed for reindexing or source call back.
Data management features optimize resources, enhance flexibility and drive scalability
OpenSearch 3.0 provides major advancements in how the platform ingests, transports and manages data including:
Support for gRPC:
Enables faster and more efficient data transport and data processing for OpenSearch deployments. This experimental feature provides a new approach to data transport between clients, servers, and node-to-node communications in OpenSearch.
Pull-based Ingestion:
Enhances ingestion efficiency and gives OpenSearch more control over the flow of data and when it’s retrieved by decoupling data sources and data consumers. This experimental feature also allows users to pull data from streaming systems like Apache Kafka and Amazon Kinesis.
Reader and Writer Separation:
Ensures consistent, high-quality performance for indexing and search workloads by configuring each in isolation, allowing both workloads to work at optimal speed and scale, rather than decreasing in efficiency when the other is taxed.
Apache Calcite Integration:
Enables intuitive, iterative query building and exploration by integrating the query builder into OpenSearch SQL and PPL. Simplifies use cases for security, observability and log analysis.
Index Type Detection:
Enhances productivity by automatically determining whether an OpenSearch index contains log-related data and speeding up log analysis feature selection.
Core upgrades help future-proof OpenSearch’s search platform and analytics suite
Enhancements to the platform’s search infrastructure – removing legacy code, adopting a modular architecture and aligning with the latest Java advancements – boosts maintainability, performance potential, and efficiency. Updates include:
Lucene 10 Upgrade:
Modernizes the platform’s search infrastructure to ensure long-term innovation, improve indexing and search capabilities, and increase performance of parallel task execution.
Java 21 Minimum Supported Runtime:
Enables access to modern language features and performance improvements.

43917122.article_summary: OpenSearch 3.0发布，性能大幅提升，相较1.3版本提升9.5倍，并比主要竞争对手快1.6倍。该版本专注于解决AI应用中大规模矢量数据处理的速度、成本和扩展性问题，支持生成式AI、混合搜索、检索增强生成（RAG）等功能。新特性包括GPU加速矢量引擎，提升性能并降低成本达3.75倍；支持模型上下文协议（MCP），增强AI代理通信能力；以及通过“派生源”功能减少存储消耗。此外，增强的数据管理功能如gRPC支持、拉取式数据摄入和读写分离优化了资源使用和扩展性。核心升级包括Lucene 10和Java 21的支持，确保平台未来创新和效率。OpenSearch 3.0旨在为社区提供开放、可扩展的搜索和分析平台。

data.title: Samsung is paying $350M for audio brands B&W, Denon, Marantz and Polk
data.author: thibautg
data.article_summary: 哈曼国际（Samsung全资子公司）将以3.5亿美元收购Masimo音频业务，预计2025年底完成，仍需监管批准。Harman是Samsung于2017年以80亿美元收购的独立运营子公司，旗下品牌包括JBL、Harman Kardon等。此次收购完成后，Masimo音频品牌如Bowers & Wilkins、Denon、Marantz和Polk Audio将加入Harman。Harman总裁表示，合并后将增强音频产品创新和消费者选择。Samsung计划将新品牌的音频技术应用于智能手机、电视、无线耳机和音响等设备，以巩固其全球消费音频市场第一的地位。收购是否导致裁员尚不明确。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：三星收购多家音响品牌及其潜在影响

不同观点：
• **对三星收购的担忧**：
  - [trentnix] 认为三星会通过更多途径推送臃肿软件（bloatware）和广告，影响用户体验，并对数据收集行为表示不满。
  - [dredmorbius] 和 [scblock] 提到之前三星对AKG的处理不佳，担心这次收购会导致这些音响品牌的质量下降。
  - [Uptrenda] 直接表达对三星可能搞砸Denon的担忧。

• **对音响行业变化的看法**：
  - [cjk] 对B&W被收购感到难过，希望三星不会毁掉公司，但也指出如果员工能保持自主性，结果可能会好。
  - [bob1029] 回顾Polk曾经是性价比很高的音响品牌，表达对过去优质产品的怀念。
  - [SoftTalker] 感叹Marantz等昔日高端音响品牌如今变成韩国大规模生产的贴牌产品，感到惋惜。

• **关于市场竞争和反垄断的讨论**：
  - [dsr_] 指出家庭影院接收器的制造商较少，Denon和Marantz长期占据重要位置，担心市场集中度提高。
  - [fblp] 提出这次收购是否会引发反垄断问题。

• **对技术问题的实际体验**：
  - [tzs] 分享了使用三星电视和显示器时遥控器互相干扰的问题，担心类似情况会发生在Denon和Marantz接收器上。

• **对品牌和市场营销的批评**：
  - [Animats] 提到在购买家电时发现不同品牌的产品实际上内部结构相同，只是外壳不同，批评品牌多样性的虚假性。

• **对家庭影院接收器存在价值的质疑**：
  - [bhouston] 认为随着无线音响和电视直接连接音响的普及，家庭影院接收器的存在价值已经不大，只有在超高端应用中才有意义。

补充讨论：
- 对收购价格的惊讶：[mrandish] 对四家公司仅以3.5亿美元出售感到意外。
- 对技术问题的抱怨：[marcoc] 提到遭遇过多请求错误，可能与技术故障有关。

争议焦点：
- 三星是否会毁掉这些知名音响品牌，以及此次收购是否会引发反垄断问题。

Read full article
mariella moon
Contributing Reporter
Wed, May 7, 2025, 6:15 AM
·
2 min read
0
Bowers & Wilkins
Harman International, a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung, is
purchasing
the audio business of health technology company Masimo for $350 million in cash. The deal is expected to finalized by the end of 2025, though it's still subject to regulatory approvals. Samsung
purchased Harman International
back in 2017 for $8 billion, though it allowed the company to operate as an independent subsidiary. Harman's brands include JBL,
Harman Kardon
, AKG, Mark Levinson, Arcam and Revel. If and when the acquisition pushes through, Masimo's audio brands under Sound United will be added to the list, including
Bowers & Wilkins
,
Denon
,
Marantz
and
Polk Audio
.
It is unclear if the purchase will lead to layoffs, but it sounds like Harman is taking on Sound United's employees. "Built on a shared legacy of innovation and excellence in audio technology, this combined family of brands, together with the talented employees of both companies, will deliver complementary audio products, strengthen our value proposition and offer more choices to consumers," said Dave Rogers, the President of Harman's Lifestyle division.
As noted by
The Verge
, Samsung
published
a press release, where it briefly talked about the history of the brands it's acquiring. It mentioned some of Bowers & Wilkins' most iconic products, such as the Nautilus loudspeaker (pictured above) and its
Zeppelin wireless speaker
, as well as Denon's history as an early adopter of the CD player. Harman had a 60 percent market share in portable audio devices last year, and the company is looking to maintain that position with this purchase. "By combining the audio business of Masimo, which is being acquired this time, with Harman’s lifestyle business division, the company plans to solidify its global No. 1 position in the consumer audio market," Samsung said. Samsung also plans to apply the new brands' audio technologies to its smartphones, TVs, wireless earphones, soundbars and other devices in the future.

data.title: Know Your Enemy: How Three Years at McKinsey Shaped My Second Startup
data.author: zt
data.article_summary: 文章的主要内容是作者在创办自己的公司之前，曾在麦肯锡担任副合伙人三年，目的是为了解竞争对手并获得实际和理想上的好处。实际原因包括赚钱和提升简历的声望，而理想原因则是通过观察大型银行和保险公司的具体挑战，找到可以创业解决的问题。在麦肯锡，作者参与了两类项目：帮助传统企业创建新业务单元和处理风险合规问题。通过这些项目，作者认识到产品开发与分销优势之间的互补关系，并领悟到要在高度监管的市场中取得成功，必须具备不易被复制的差异化产品和利用盲点的分销策略。此外，作者还观察到大型机构在自我革新方面面临的困难，进一步确认了治理大型机构的挑战。

不同观点：
• **对创业公司愿景的道德和实际性质疑**：[throw10920] 认为，文章中提到的创业公司计划通过100名员工服务10亿人，依赖AI和自动化来实现盈利，这可能意味着剥夺用户与人类互动机会，这在道德上难以接受。

• **对保险与比特币混合的质疑**：[johnobrien1010] 指出，将人寿保险与比特币结合是不合适的，因为人寿保险是提供家庭安全的受监管产品，而比特币是高度投机的资产，二者不应混合。

• **对咨询公司背景创始人的看法**：[Fomite] 和 [TrackerFF] 提到，咨询公司背景的创始人往往带有咨询业的思维方式，并认为这在创业中是难以摆脱的，但同时在某些国家这是进入创业的常见路径，尤其是在规避风险的投资环境中。

• **对McKinsey工作经历的批评**：[nforgerit] 分享了与McKinsey合作的不良经验，指出其在技术项目上的表现不佳，且工程师缺乏技术深度。

• **对文章内容和标题的失望**：[JohnMakin] 认为文章更像LinkedIn帖子，期望看到更多关于大公司问题的实质性讨论，而不仅仅是创业推销。

• **对人寿保险和比特币结合的潜在市场需求**：[w10-1] 认为，尽管对比特币和骗局有关联的担忧，但在当前政治腐败和市场波动的情况下，独立于监管或法律的技术保障可能具有吸引力。

• **对McKinsey式语言的批评**：[Oras] 认为文章中的愿景描述是空洞的 corporate BS，没有实际内容。

补充讨论：
• **对文章中时间错误的指出**：[Lienetic] 提到文章中关于ChatGPT的时间描述可能有误。

• **对McKinsey参与负面事件的提及**：[mentalgear] 联想到McKinsey在一些重大社会问题中的负面角色，如游说烟草和阿片类药物。

• **对个人职业选择的反思**：[georgeburdell] 分享了自己在面试McKinsey时对高学历人才浪费的感受，以及后来对博士职业轨道的反思和希望转向“无聊”业务的愿望。

• 创业公司通过AI和自动化实现大规模服务的目标是否道德和可行。

43886604.article_content:
“If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles. If you know yourself but not the enemy, for every victory gained you will also suffer a defeat. If you know neither the enemy nor yourself, you will succumb in every battle.”
I worked as an Associate Partner at McKinsey for three years before starting
Meanwhile
. Folks often find that surprising. I wasn’t the only YC graduate there but there weren’t many of us.
I did this for both practical and aspirational reasons.
Let me get the practical reasons out of the way:
I wanted to make money and provide stability to my family after having worked four jobs in three years.
McKinsey is prestigious.{1} I had never worked at a traditionally recognizable company, so I wanted to derisk my resume by working somewhere with high signaling.{2}
The work was more interesting than {insert name brand tech company, and the people were, on average, more curious.
Let me unpack the aspirational reason I joined. I wanted to understand my competition. I thought McKinsey would be a great way to see many concrete challenges inside large banks and insurers. I could then pick a problem to tackle in my next company. That didn’t quite work out exactly but I learned deeper truths about where startups can win and compete.
A common criticism of McKinsey is that clients hire them to give answers they already know. It’s all just cover-your-ass. I am sure that happens (perhaps a lot), but in my ~25 engagements at McKinsey, I can honestly say that not once did I think the client already knew the answer.
Most of my time was split across two types of projects: building new things inside incumbents and helping incumbents address deep-seated risk/compliance topics around or through technology.
On the first, McKinsey has this practice called “
Leap by McKinsey,
” where a client hires them to build a new business unit, a new division, or a new “startup” within the company. I would go in and be the “entrepreneur in residence” along with a core startup team, like a CTO or head of product. I’d serve as the interim “GM” or “CEO” of this new initiative. The team would grow with folks from the client. Then we would slowly replace ourselves with leaders from the company, coaching them through the transition until we were out of a job.
This was really fun, actually. I got to start one startup a year for three years. And the big lesson here is that if you can create a team that ships inside one of these companies, you can grow very quickly. Two of those three projects got to $25M in ARR (or equivalent) in my time working on them. If you launch something decent (I won’t even say good) inside a big incumbent, they will sell the hell out of it. They have an install base, they have salespeople, and they have enterprise relationships.
The adage that "first-time founders are obsessed with product, and second-time founders are obsessed with distribution" took on new meaning for me through these projects. What I discovered wasn't just that distribution matters—that's obvious—but that the relationship between product development and distribution advantage is symbiotic rather than sequential. At McKinsey, I witnessed how even incremental product improvements could achieve remarkable traction when paired with established distribution channels. But I also observed the limitations: when incumbents tried to disrupt themselves or their industry genuinely, organizational gravity often pulled them back toward the familiar. This tension revealed a critical insight that would later shape Meanwhile: to break into a highly-regulated, commoditized market like insurance, you need both a truly differentiated product that incumbents can't easily replicate and an associated distribution strategy that leverages their blind spots.
On the second project type, I worked on risk transformations for two of the Big Four banks.{3} These projects are very high-profile, critical projects that no one is happy about. They are driven by some regulatory mandate from the Fed or the OCC or whoever, who has made clear that the bank doesn’t have control of their risk and compliance issues. Usually data, technology, tracking, metrics, etc, is a huge part of both the problem and the presumed solution.
This work was less “fun’ but perhaps more instructive. On one level, it made me wonder whether any scaled institution is governable. If you have hundreds of thousands of employees, whether you're a huge bank or the California State Government (where I was inaugural Chief Data Officer), I’m not sure there is any system you can set up to make it work. I’ve become sympathetic to
Brandeis’s notion of a Curse of Bigness
.
To be less abstract, though, there is no fixing institutions that have gotten so big. They can build a new business unit that does something innovative (well, if they hired me), but reforming their core business is impossible. Just too many people, too many processes, too much regulatory overhang. But if

data.title: Pentagon to shake up "outdated" software procurement—declares war on open source
data.author: voxadam
data.article_summary: 美国国防部（DOD）计划通过新的软件快速通道（SWFT）计划，在未来90天内改革过时的软件采购系统，以提升安全性和供应链可见性。DOD首席信息官Katherine Arrington在一份备忘录中指出，当前系统过时，无法满足部门所需的敏捷性，新框架将明确网络安全和供应链风险管理（SCRM）要求，加强软件安全验证和信息共享机制。此外，开源软件的可见性问题和软件漏洞也是改革重点，因为这些漏洞常被攻击者利用。与此同时，DOD的效率部门（DOGE）已通过各种措施节省了约60亿美元。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕DOD（美国国防部）采购系统、成本节约声明以及软件使用（开源与 proprietary 软件）的讨论和批评。

不同观点：
• **cosmicgadget** 认为，DOD 的采购系统已经破碎，任何试图改变这一系统的人都可能以有利于军工复合体（M-IC）的方式再次破坏它。该评论表达了对系统改革的不信任，隐含对现行系统中利益链条的批评。

• **nitwit005** 认为，这篇评论是在对一份简短的备忘录进行总结，且在末尾无理由地提到了DOGE（狗狗币）。这一观点质疑了讨论中对DOGE提及的相关性，认为这是不必要的附加信息。

• **colanderman** 批评了DOD关于成本节约的声明，认为它无理由地重复了特朗普时期的宣传。评论指出，所谓的“节约”缺乏证据，有些甚至是虚构的，类似于通过削减重要服务来实现节约，这种节约方式并不真正有益。评论还引用了纽约时报的文章来支持其观点。

• **RugnirViking** 对使用开源软件和 proprietary 软件的讨论提出了质疑，认为转向 proprietary 软件（无法查看代码）反而会使得软件的来源和安全性更加不透明，与通常认为开源软件可能带来安全风险的观点相反。

补充讨论：
• **colanderman** 引用的纽约时报文章链接（虽然为虚构的2025年日期）试图为他的批评提供外部证据，质疑DOD所声称的节约数据的真实性。

• 争议焦点在于DOD的成本节约声明是否真实可信，以及在软件采购中选择开源还是 proprietary 软件的合理性。评论中对“节约”的定义存在不同理解，一方认为这是削减成本的虚假宣传，另一方则质疑软件透明性和安全性问题。

43916839.article_content:
(Image credit: CloudPro)
The US DOD wants to enhance security through unlocking greater supply chain visibility
A new Software Fast-Track Initiative will arrive in the next 90 days
The DOGE has already saved the DOD $6 billion
The US Department of Defense (DOD) is planning to overhaul its outdated software procurement systems, which it hopes will enhance security and supply chain visibility in a world of increasing vulnerabilities.
DOD CIO Katherine Arrington introduced the Software Fast-Track (SWFT) initiative to reform software acquisition, as well as authorization and testing, in a
memo
published online.
Arrington confirmed that, together with the Under Secretaries of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainbment, Intelligence and Security, and Research and Engineering, the DOD will submit the SWFT Framework within 90 days.
You may like
US DOD wants right-to-repair provisions in Army contracts to access tools, software, and technical data without IP constraints
Removing software supply chain blind spots that put public sector organizations at risk
DOGE planning “hackathon” to build a “mega API” for accessing all IRS and taxpayer data
Dated software procurement processes
In the memo, Arrington explained the SWFT Framework will define "clear" and "specific" cybersecurity and Supple Chain Risk Management (SCRM) requirements, rigorous software security verification processes, secure information sharing mechanisms and Federal Government-led risk determinations to expedite the cybersecurity authorizations for rapid software adoption.
She continued to explain that current systems are best seen as "outdated," noting that acquisition processes don't enable the agility that departments need.
Arrington also noted that the use of
open source software
"presents a significant and ongoing challenge," with a lack of visibility into the origins and security of software code particularly troubling.
Malware and partner leaks have already exposed vulnerabilities in DOD systems, with software vulnerabilities among the most popular entry points for attackers.

data.title: Web search on the Anthropic API
data.author: cmogni1
data.article_summary: Anthropic推出了Anthropic API上的网页搜索功能，使Claude能够访问实时的网络信息。开发者可以利用这一工具构建基于Claude的应用程序和代理，提供最新的洞察。Claude能够根据需求自动进行网页搜索，生成有引用的回答，并进行多步搜索以完善答案。该功能支持多个应用场景，如金融服务、法律研究、开发者工具和生产力应用。组织可以通过允许或禁止特定域的搜索来控制信息来源。网页搜索现已在Anthropic API的多个Claude版本上可用，价格为每1000次搜索10美元，外加标准token费用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大型语言模型（LLM）在网络搜索中的应用及其技术与成本分析

不同观点：
• **多跳搜索与查询优化**：cmogni1指出多跳搜索和基于先前上下文/搜索的查询优化是一个有趣且复杂的问题。虽然可以通过URL的上下文实现，但技术上很复杂且成本高昂。此外，搜索结果的相关性与LLM的相关性不匹配，导致需要基于更丰富的上下文重新排序结果，例如撰写关于Accutane副作用的文章时应优先选择科研文章而非博客。

• **搜索成本问题**：jarbus认为每次搜索的成本较高，期待未来成本下降。minimaxir则指出相较于Google的Gemini，某些API在大量使用时更便宜。

• **域名限制与功能可用性**：benjamoon赞赏允许域名列表功能，使其在客户项目中更具实用性。而OpenAI的API目前不支持此功能。

• **自建搜索工具与定制化**：omneity介绍了自己创建的免费AI搜索工具，可以连接到任何模型，并支持多页结果，强调了定制化优势。

• **搜索技术与实现方式**：simianwords质疑是否使用自定义网络索引或Bing/Google API，并讨论了向量嵌入在网络搜索中的必要性，认为纯文本搜索可能已经足够。

• **成本与能耗**：elisson22关心执行任务的能耗成本是否显著。

• **输入输出成本问题**：potlee提到如果使用自己的搜索工具，每次模型搜索时都需要再次支付输入 tokens，质疑是否仅对所有输出 tokens收费一次。

• **结果存储与隐私**：simonw关心是否可以永久存储搜索结果，并猜测是否使用类似于Brave的隐私保护技术。

• **搜索提供商配置**：aaronscott希望能够配置搜索提供商，比如使用Kagi。

• **AI聊天与网络搜索的关系**：metalrain认为AI聊天不会使网络搜索过时，而是更深入地嵌入技术栈，可能促使Google从广告转向B2B的API交易。

• **功能限制与组合问题**：lemming关心其他限制，例如Gemini的搜索工具无法与其他工具组合使用的问题。

• **搜索结果排序质量比较**：zhyder关注三大LLM提供商在搜索结果排序质量上的比较，指出未来最佳LLM可能依赖于最佳的网络搜索排序，正如Google当年凭借优秀排序胜出。

补充讨论：
• 多跳搜索的技术与成本问题是一个核心争议点，涉及到LLM在实际应用中的复杂性和经济性。
• 搜索结果的相关性与LLM相关性的匹配问题，以及如何基于丰富上下文进行结果重排，也是讨论的重点。
• 搜索成本和能耗的讨论显示了用户对经济性和技术可行性的关注。
• 自建搜索工具的提出，展示了用户在定制化和隐私保护方面的需求。

Product
Introducing web search on the Anthropic API
May 7, 2025
●
3 min
read
Today, we're introducing web search on the Anthropic API—a new tool that gives Claude access to current information from across the web. With web search enabled, developers can build Claude-powered applications and agents that deliver up-to-date insights.
Power AI agents with the latest information from the web
Developers can now augment Claude’s comprehensive knowledge with current, real-world data by enabling the web search tool when making requests to the Messages API.
When Claude receives a request that would benefit from up-to-date information or specialized knowledge, it uses its reasoning capabilities to determine whether the web search tool would help provide a more accurate response. If searching the web would be beneficial, Claude generates a targeted search query, retrieves relevant results, analyzes them for key information, and provides a comprehensive answer with citations back to the source material.
Claude can also operate agentically and conduct multiple progressive searches, using earlier results to inform subsequent queries in order to do light research and generate a more comprehensive answer. Developers can control this by adjusting the
max_uses
parameter
.
Behind the scenes, Claude may also refine its queries to deliver a more accurate response.
With web search, developers can now build AI solutions that tap into current information without needing to manage their own web search infrastructure.
Use cases
Web search enables Claude to power a wide range of use cases that benefit from real-time data and specialized knowledge across various industries. Use cases include:
Financial services:
Build AI agents that analyze real-time stock prices, market trends, and regulatory updates.
Legal research:
Create tools that access recent court decisions, regulatory changes, and legal news.
Developer tools:
Enable Claude to reference the latest API documentation, GitHub releases, and technology updates.
Productivity:
Build agents that incorporate the latest company reports, competitive intelligence, or industry research.
Build with trust and control
Every web-sourced response includes citations to source materials, enabling users to verify information directly. This is particularly valuable for sensitive use cases that require accuracy and accountability.
Organizations can maintain additional control through the following admin settings:
Domain allow lists
: Specify which domains Claude can search and retrieve information from, ensuring that results only come from approved sources.
Domain block lists
: Prevent Claude from accessing certain domains that may contain sensitive, competitive, or inappropriate content for your organization.
Organization-level management
: Administrators can allow or prohibit web search use at the organization level.
Enhance Claude Code with web search
Web search is also now available in Claude Code, adding the latest information from the web to development workflows.
With web search enabled, Claude Code can access current API documentation, technical articles, and other information on development tools and libraries. This is particularly valuable when working with new or rapidly evolving frameworks, troubleshooting obscure errors, or implementing features that require version-specific API references.
Customer Spotlight: Poe
Quora is bringing web search to its AI platform, Poe.
“Anthropic's web search tool is a welcome addition to the Poe platform. It is cost effective and delivers search results with impressive speed, which will benefit people who need access to real-time information while using Claude models on Poe,” said Spencer Chan, Head of Poe Product, Quora.
Customer Spotlight: Adaptive.ai
Adaptive is an AI tool for consumers to create end-to-end apps.
“Anthropic’s web search delivers consistently thorough results that have outperformed other tools we’ve tested. The depth and accuracy of Claude’s responses and its ability to function as a research agent will make a significant difference in how effectively we enable our customers to build web-enabled products,” said Dennis Xu, Co-founder, Adaptive.
Getting started
Web search is now available on the Anthropic API for Claude 3.7 Sonnet, the upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku at $10 per 1,000 searches plus standard token costs.
To get started, enable the web search tool in your API requests. Explore our
documentation
and
pricing
to learn more.

• **搜索成本问题**：jarbus认为每次搜索的成本较高，期待未来成本下降。minimaxir则指出相较于Google的Gemini，某些API在大量使用时更便宜。

• **域名限制与功能可用性**：benjamoon赞赏允许域名列表功能，使其在客户项目中更具实用性。而OpenAI的API目前不支持此功能。

• **自建搜索工具与定制化**：omneity介绍了自己创建的免费AI搜索工具，可以连接到任何模型，并支持多页结果，强调了定制化优势。

• **成本与能耗**：elisson22关心执行任务的能耗成本是否显著。

data.title: Open source Google Analytics replacement
data.author: samdung
data.article_summary: Rybbit 是一个开源且注重隐私的网站和产品分析工具，是 Google Analytics 的替代品。它易于设置，并且在使用上非常直观。Rybbit 提供关键的网页分析指标，如会话、独立用户、页面浏览量等，且不使用 cookies，符合 GDPR 和 CCPA 标准。它支持定制目标、用户旅程、漏斗图仪表盘，并提供实时仪表盘、高级过滤和三层地理位置追踪等功能。用户可以选择使用 Rybbit 的托管服务或自行部署，支持多个站点和组织。该项目基于 AGPL-3.0 许可证，主要使用 TypeScript 开发。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Google Analytics替代品的市场竞争与差异化

不同观点：
• nm980认为Google Analytics替代品市场竞争激烈，许多产品功能相似且提供免费 tier，而rybbit仅提供免费试用，质疑其如何保持竞争力，尤其是是否通过托管计划创收。
• Apreche提出一种极端的观点，认为完全不使用分析工具也是一种选择，网站可以在没有分析工具的情况下正常运行。
• karolist分享了自己的经历，使用Cloudflare的分析显示每日有80个独立访客，但安装Umami后显示0访客，怀疑是否因互联网上的LLM爬虫导致数据差异。
• indiantinker表示使用Umami是为了获得一种心理上的满足感，看到有人访问自己的页面可以减少孤独感。
• ksec认为rybbit与Umami非常相似，质疑是否是其分支，并指出技术上的相似性（TypeScript / Next.JS和设计）。
• gitroom关注隐私和易用性的长期重要性，提出哪一个因素在长期中更重要的问题。
• AndrewStephens对rybbit的GDPR合规性提出质疑，指出虽然不使用cookies，但通过IP地址进行跟踪可能并不比cookies更好。
• dhosek回顾了Google Analytics之前就存在的许多分析工具，认为基于日志分析的工具可能是最好的选择。
• VladVladikoff寻找不依赖JavaScript的服务器端开源分析软件，表达了对减少页面上的非必要JavaScript的需求。
• codazoda对onedollarstats.com感兴趣，但因缺乏隐私信息而犹豫是否使用，目前使用自制的计数器但功能有限。
• kull和nadermx分别推荐了Matomo和clicky.com作为替代方案。

补充讨论：
• 多个评论提到对简单工具的偏好，以及对隐私保护的重视（如nadermx使用clicky.com，codazoda关注隐私问题）。
• 争议的焦点在于分析工具的必要性（Apreche的观点）以及不同工具的隐私保护措施（如AndrewStephens对GDPR合规性的质疑）。
• 有人关注技术实现（如ksec对技术相似性的讨论，VladVladikoff对服务器端工具的需求）。
• 市场竞争激烈是共识，许多人提到选择众多，如何脱颖而出是一个挑战。

总结来看，讨论围绕替代品的市场竞争、隐私保护、技术实现以及用户需求的多样性展开，不同用户根据自己的偏好和需求提出了各自的见解。

data.title: El Cono: The mysterious sacred 'pyramid' hidden deep in the Amazon rainforest
data.author: Brajeshwar
data.article_summary: Cerro El Cono, also known as "Montaña Cónica," is a 1,310-foot pyramid-like formation in the Peruvian Amazon rainforest. Located in the Sierra del Divisor, it stands isolated from nearby mountains and is notable for its steep, mysterious shape, visible from as far as the Andes. The origin of this unique peak remains unclear, with theories ranging from an extinct volcano to a natural rock formation, and even speculative suggestions of an ancient Indigenous-built pyramid. Local Indigenous tribes regard it as a spiritual entity or "Andean Apu," a sacred mountain spirit. The surrounding area, rich in biodiversity, was designated as the Sierra del Divisor National Park in 2015 to protect it from illegal activities, though threats like deforestation persist.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一篇关于埃尔科诺火山锥的文章及其内容和网站设计的评价与讨论

不同观点：
• **[willvarfar]** 分享了一个替代链接，提供了文章中提到的埃尔科诺火山锥的图片，旨在补充信息和视觉参考。
• **[cm2187]** 认为该地点并不偏远，距离机场不到100公里，通过短途直升机可以到达，并推测应该有人已经探索过该地点以了解植被下的情况。

43887304.article_content:
Cerro El Cono is isolated from a nearby mountain range and has an unusual shape.
(Image credit: Newscom/Alamy)
QUICK FACTS
Name:
Cerro El Cono, also known as "Montaña Cónica"
Location:
Sierra del Divisor, Peruvian Amazon rainforest
Coordinates:
-7.963010971488621, -73.78224313086483
Why it's incredible:
El Cono stands alone in the rainforest and has a mysterious pyramidal shape.
Cerro El Cono is a 1,310-foot-tall (400 meters), pyramid-like formation in the
Amazon rainforest
. It rises steeply from the relatively flat jungle landscape of eastern Peru, making it visible from as far west as the Andes — 250 miles (400 kilometers) away — on a clear day.
The formation, whose name translates to "cone hill," is located in a mountainous region on the border between Peru and Brazil known as the Sierra del Divisor. The mountains are visible in the background of most photographs of Cerro El Cono, but the formation is isolated from the other peaks and has an unusual pyramidal shape, making it stand out from the rest of the mountain range.
The origins of the strange peak have remained mysterious due to its remote location. While some
sources
suggest that the cone could be an extinct volcano, others say it might simply be an unusual rock formation.
Related:
Mount Roraima: The 'lost world' isolated for millions of years that Indigenous people call the 'house of the gods'
Indigenous people have another explanation for the bizarre mountain: According to the Peruvian newspaper
La República
, Cerro El Cono is a spiritual entity for local tribes and groups, some of which revere the peak as an "Andean Apu" — a sacred mountain god or spirit. In the mythologies of Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador, Apus emerged from Earth to guide and protect the people living close by.
A fourth explanation — one for which there is no evidence — is that Cerro El Cono sits on the ruins of a pyramid built by ancient Indigenous tribes, according to La República.
MORE INCREDIBLE PLACES
—
Iran's folded rocks: The crumpled mountains at the intersection of Asia and Europe
—
Wilkes Land crater: The giant hole in East Antarctica's gravitational field likely caused by a meteorite
—
Rainbow Mountains: China's psychedelic landscape created when 2 tectonic plates collided
Cerro El Cono stands adjacent to the Ucayali River, which is a major tributary of the
Amazon River
. The surrounding jungle is a biodiversity hotspot and home to several vulnerable species, including giant armadillos (
Priodontes maximus
), jaguars (
Panthera onca
) and various types of monkeys, according to
The Guardian
. The peak itself is forested and forms part of a large area that has been considered a biodiversity conservation priority since the 1990s.

Concern that this ecosystem may become degraded by infrastructure, illegal logging and gold mining prompted the creation of the Sierra del Divisor National Park in 2015. But
recent surveys
indicate that the protected park, which is 1.5 times the size of Yellowstone National Park, has not removed threats from illegal deforestation and wildlife poaching.

data.title: How to Average in Prolog (2017)
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 这篇文章以讽刺的口吻讨论了如何用Prolog计算一组数字的平均值，强调了在学校作业中往往不允许使用Prolog简洁的高层库函数，而需要手动实现各种辅助函数。文章首先给出了一种符合数学定义的平均值计算方法，然后为了符合作业要求，将其转换为更复杂、更冗长的递归形式。作者通过这种方式批评了教育中过于注重形式化和无意义的繁琐步骤，而不是实际应用和解决问题。文章的重点是：1) Prolog拥有简洁高效的标准库，但在学校作业中通常禁止使用；2) 任何过程式循环都可以通过创建递归辅助谓词在Prolog中实现。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Prolog教学中的人工限制、教学方法的价值以及对教师的批评

不同观点：
• [timonoko] 认为Grok无法处理Prolog，并指出在Prolog中坚持使用特定语法（如`average([X],X) :- !.`）而不是更简单的形式是没有必要的，暗示这种做法是多余的。

• [fuzz_junket] 反对对教师的批评，认为学习基础原理是有价值的。他指出教师并不是在浪费学生时间，而是在帮助学生从基础开始实现功能。他还提到对教师使用贬义词如"clueless professors"是不尊重的。此外，fuzz_junket澄清了Prolog没有标准库，不同实现提供的谓词可能不同，编写可移植代码需要遵循ISO标准。

• [danilafe] 对文章中的抱怨感到不解，认为自己从未见过Prolog课程会故意设置障碍使Prolog看起来枯燥乏味。他质疑文章中的笑话意图，并提出关于逆向解决方案（如`sum(?, 10)`)是否更适合通过直接或繁琐的方法实现的问题，表示对两者效果的好奇。

• [Pinus] 从自身30多年前的逻辑编程课程经验出发，认为课程中设置人工限制（如"禁止使用标准库"）是为了帮助学生掌握基础原理，并通过反复练习使这些原理内化。他将此与Lisp和微积分中的教学方法进行类比，强调练习基础技能的重要性。不过，他也承认有些教师可能会布置无意义的作业。

• [pjmlp] 赞赏对"only tools available in the 18th century"的讽刺，认为这适用于主流计算中的许多情况。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Prolog教学中的人工限制是否必要，以及这种教学方法是否被贬低为无意义的忙碌工作。部分评论者认为这些限制有助于掌握基础原理，而另一些则认为这些限制不必要且可能导致学生不满。
• 对教师的批评也引发了讨论，部分评论者认为对教师的不尊重言辞不恰当，强调教师在帮助学生学习基础技能方面的努力和价值。
• Prolog没有标准库的事实也成为讨论的一部分，强调了在不同实现间编写可移植代码的挑战。

43919959.article_content:
Daniel's Blog
Home
Archives
Search
Feed
About
If I had to
average a list of numbers
, I would probably do it like this:
averagelist(List, Avg) :-
length(List, N), sumlist(List, Sum),
Avg is Sum / N.
This resembles the actual mathematical definition. Then you
could
just make a list of numbers and average that. @lurker is right, this is a terrible way to go, but it would work:
average(N, Avg) :-
findall(I, between(1, N, I), Is),
averagelist(Is, Avg).
This is building up abstraction. But of course, this is for a class and the important thing is to not use Prolog or learn declarative programming or solve actual problems but rather to perform meaningless inductive calisthenics to prove you understand recursion. So a
“
better” (i.e. worse but likelier to be accepted by a clueless professor) solution is to take the procedural code:
average(list) ::=
sum := 0
count := 0
repeat with i ∈ list
sum := sum + i
count := count + 1
return sum / count
and convert it into equivalent Prolog code:
average(List, Result) :- average(List, 0, 0, Result).
average([], Sum, Count, Result) :- Result is Sum / Count.
average([X|Xs], Sum, Count, Result) :-
Sum1 is Sum + X,
succ(Count, Count1),
average(Xs, Sum1, Count1, Result).
The list result of my
findall/3
must be delicately hand-assembled using only tools available in the 18th century lest anyone develop a sense that Prolog can be used effectively in fewer than 40 lines of code:
iota(N, Result)        :- iota(1, N, Result).
iota(X, Y, [X|Result]) :- X < Y, succ(X,X1), iota(X1, Y, Result).
iota(X, X, [X]).
Then you could build
averagelist/2
without the taint of library code (of course, you’ll have to write
length/2
and
sumlist/2
, and probably
member/2
even though it isn’t used, but just because it’s clever and useful and it sort of seems like it should be in the source file next to all this other stuff we might need), but it would look generally like this:
average(N, Avg) :-
iota(N, List),
averagelist(List, Avg).
Now, of course, it will be pointed out that the introduction of additional predicates that are not directly answers to the take home assignment are illegitimate and will be penalized as doing such leads to readability, maintainability, breaking problems down into manageable pieces and other things that are not directly related to the goal of the assignment (to make Prolog appear tedious yet opaque) so we could now look at this and realize that if we want to flatten these two predicates together we ought to be able to by just smushing together their state variables and doing all the work of both, like this:
average(N, Avg) :- average(1, N, 0, 0, Avg).
average(X, Y, Sum, Count, Avg) :-
X < Y,
Sum1 is Sum + X,
succ(Count, Count1),
succ(X, X1),
average(X1, Y, Sum1, Count1, Avg).
average(X, X, Sum, Count, Avg) :-
Sum1 is Sum + X,
succ(Count, Count1),
Avg is Sum1 / Count1.
Now this is starting to look like Professor of Programming Languages code! We went from basically four little readable lines to 9 or 10 repetitive lines and a lot of book-keeping and state! I think we’re on the right track now, let’s review how it works:
average/2
is just a call to
average/5
with our state initialized (no sum, no count, starting value = 1).
average/5
has two cases: a base case where the count-up-to value and the current-count value are equal, and an inductive case where the current-count is less.
add up the blah blah blah you get the point
The key takeaways here are: 1) Prolog has a terse, high-level, readable and comprehensible standard library, which you are prohibited from using in school, and 2) any procedural loop can be made working Prolog by creating a recursive helper predicate and moving the code around.

data.title: Mac Themes Garden
data.author: speckx
data.article_summary: 2025年5月5日，作者推出了"Mac Themes Garden"网站，展示超过3000个经典Mac时代的Kaleidoscope主题，供用户浏览、下载和探索。网站还提供RSS订阅源，方便用户跟踪主题的更新。该项目源自作者运营的Mac Themes Bot，最初在Bluesky、Mastodon和Cohost上展示Mac OS X和经典Mac主题。由于原始数据获取困难，作者通过手动截图记录约4000个Kaleidoscope主题的信息，包括主题的作者和发布年份。由于过程复杂且耗时，目前网站建设尚未完成，但已上线供用户使用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对过去计算机界面高度可定制性的怀念与现代操作系统的 blandness（乏味）和限制。

不同观点：
• **怀旧与赞赏多样性**：
  - **red_admiral**：怀念过去在多个平台上自定义窗口主题、颜色等的自由，特别是GTK和GNOME社区的主题设计。尽管可能只有1%的人使用，但用户对自己GUI风格的选择感更强。
  - **rhet0rica**：赞赏Mac主题设计的多样性，特别是像Martha Royer这样的艺术家创作了大量主题。相比之下，Windows社区的定制性较弱，且风格较为单一。
  - **cosmic_cheese**：怀念Classic Mac OS时代的定制能力，尽管存在安全问题，但希望现代操作系统能够以更安全的方式恢复这种灵活性。

• **对现代操作系统的失望**：
  - **rf15**：认为如今的操作系统只剩下“企业赞助的乏味设计”，用户不再关心定制，只将其作为浏览网页的工具。
  - **hoistbypetard**：表示愿意付费以在现代Linux系统上使用经典Mac OS主题，表达对过去主题的喜爱和对现代系统的失望。

• **个人经历与技术演变**：
  - **antfarm**：回忆使用Kaleidoscope将PowerMac定制为BeOS风格，并通过扩展获得类似NeXT Cube的列浏览器功能，展示了个性化定制的技术成就。
  - **milesskorpen**：怀念过去Winamp和Mac主题定制的乐趣，不确定是自身年龄增长还是技术发展使得这种乐趣不再。

补充讨论：
• **特定功能怀念**：
  - **WillAdams**：怀念Mac OS 9中窗口标题栏在“window-shaded”时缩小的功能，认为这是他唯一怀念的旧系统特性。
  
• **技术可行性与安装问题**：
  - **ugh123**：询问这些经典主题是否可以在现代Mac上安装。
  - **betterThanTexas**：因过去没有权限定制家庭计算机而感到遗憾，并对过去未能体验更多定制乐趣表示失望。

• **对历史和社区贡献的认可**：
  - **davidmurphy**：作为计算机历史博物馆的工作人员，表达了对Mac主题设计历史的喜爱和怀旧情感。

争议焦点：经典主题定制在现代系统中的缺失与用户对定制自由的渴望。用户普遍认为现代操作系统在定制方面缺乏灵活性和乐趣。

43919868.article_content:
Introducing Mac Themes Garden!
May 5th, 2025
The short version
I've "launched" the
Mac Themes Garden
! It is a website showcasing more than 3,000 (and counting) Kaleidoscope from the Classic Mac era, ready to be seen, downloaded and explored! Check it out! Oh, and there also is an
RSS feed
you can subscribe to see themes as they are added/updated!
And yes, there is a button that you can include on your website!
Grab it here
! Isn't it cute?
Now, for the yapping.
Note: if you're reading this in an RSS reader, you might want to open the article on my website directly as it contains a bunch of CSS demos and those won't work well in an RSS reader.
Some background
If you know me from Online, you may know that I've been running the Mac Themes Bot on
Bluesky
/
Mastodon
/
Cohost
for a few years now.
The idea of the bot was simple, showcasing custom themes from the Mac OS X and Classic Mac eras, on the rate of one an hour. Since I was inspired by
@kaleidoscopemac
on Twitter, I only started showcasing themes made for
ShapeShifter by Unsanity
. A while later, that Twitter account got suspended.
Since I already had the
tooling in place
to scrape and post themes for OS X, I figured I could add themes for Kaleidoscope (OS 7/8/9) into the mix. After trying (and failing) to get the original dataset from the author of the bot, I set on to scrape the Wayback Machine for records of the
Kaleidoscope Scheme Archive
.
From that point on, my bot would post themes every hour, with a classic theme on even hours and an OS X theme on odd hours
[1]
.
The years passed, the bot carried on, made me and a bunch of other people smile on the various websites where I would run it. The
Cohost
incarnation in particular was really special because Cohost was a special site, but also it was full of nerds (complimentary) and people would go nuts for the random gems in there.
Around maybe early 2023, I grew frustrated of the fact that the only images I had for the Kaleidoscope
themes
schemes were those
tiny .gif files
from the late 90s.
"Recording" 25-year-old schemes
So I did the reasonable thing: set up a terribly manual process to take screenshots and record the author information of the
~4,000 themes available
, with the intention of making a website showcasing everything once I was done.
Without going into details (which you can read
here
), the process looks like this:
Open my Mac OS 9 VM in
UTM.app
(QEMU frontend)
Go through the folder of schemes
Select a given scheme, apply it
Take 3 screenshots:
One of the scheme's about box.
One of the scheme being used in the Finder/regular desktop situation.
And finally, a screenshot of the application
KSA Sampler
in order to mimic the original screenshots from the Kaleidoscope Scheme Archive. That specific screenshot would get pasted into Photoshop to be cropped/trimmed of its opaque background using Photoshop Actions.
Write down the name, author and release year of the scheme
Find the corresponding .sit archive file
Record all of this in a record inside an Airtable database.
Here's how it looks inside Airtable:
6 rows inside an Airtable database, showing screenshots and scheme informations
On a good day, I can maybe record, I don't know, a dozen or so themes an hour.
But Damien, why didn't you automate this process?!
I'm glad you asked! I tried! But I, at least until now, could not find a good way to reliably perform the actions I need to take. And that's not even touching on the fact that sometimes a scheme doesn't have any author or year information! Sometimes the author inside the Kaleidoscope scheme file is completely wrong, and the actual author is written in a separate "Read me" file. Sometimes there's barely any information to go by, sometimes the scheme is buggy and would crash my VM.
At that point, the only automations I have are:
a
Keyboard Maestro
macro
that calls the
qemu-monitor
for the running VM, takes a lossless screenshot and puts it into my clipboard, ready to be pasted
Photoshop actions to:
create a document from the clipboard
after cropping, remove all pixels of a given color in a document and trim it to remove extra alpha pixels (for the KSA Sampler screenshots above)
A
Quickeys
shortcut to call "Hide Others" inside of Mac OS 9. Turns out this action didn't have a keyboard shortcut until Mac OS X? Didn't know that!

data.title: Single hair-like electrode outperforms traditional 21-lead EEG
data.author: westurner
data.article_summary: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学的研究团队开发了一种3D打印的毛发状电极，用于脑电图（EEG）监测，比传统的21导联EEG更可靠。传统EEG使用多个电极和导电凝胶，存在移动时信号噪声大、凝胶易干等问题。而这种新型电极无需凝胶，采用生物粘合剂固定，可长时间佩戴，不受运动影响，信号稳定。该电极如发丝般细小，可根据使用者发色染色，不影响日常活动，且移除时不会损伤皮肤。虽然目前仍需连接线路，但研究团队计划开发无线版本，并预计其在健康和医疗领域有广泛应用前景。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新型电极技术的性能和应用前景

不同观点：
• [mmastrac] 认为新闻标题具有误导性。他指出，尽管单个头发状电极在性能（寿命和信噪比）上优于单个传统21导联EEG电极，但这并不意味着一个电极能替代多导联系统。
• [y-curious] 提供了更详细的来源，并指出新技术电极优于传统电极，但并不意味着一个新型电极可以替代24导联的整个系统。他认为新闻标题可能造成了误解。
• [6SixTy] 同意技术改进的观点，强调新型电极体积更小、头皮粘附性更好，但仍需要多个电极阵列来进行医学诊断，比如监控癫痫发作的具体位置。
• [amelius] 对电极和导线的功能提出了疑问，认为圆形垫片才是实际的电极，而“头发”状结构可能只是导线，可以用其他铜线替代。

补充讨论：
• [Euphorbium] 提到了AI在解读脑信号方面的潜力，暗示这种新技术可能推动AI在神经科学领域的应用，甚至提到AI未来可能在脑信号的读写方面取得突破。

争议焦点：
• 争议的核心在于新型电极是否能替代传统多导联EEG系统。一部分评论者认为单个新型电极无法替代多导联系统，而新闻标题可能误导了这一理解。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 新型电极在体积和头皮粘附性方面的改进。
• 电极和导线的功能区分以及可替代性。
• AI在脑信号解读和未来应用的潜力。

(original image extended using generative AI)
View gallery - 3 images
Researchers have developed a 3D-printable electrode that looks like a single strand of human hair and measures brain activity more reliably than the current method used to diagnose things like epilepsy and sleep disorders.
When you imagine someone having an
electroencephalogram
(EEG) to diagnose a condition such as epilepsy, for example, you probably picture them with a head covered in electrodes. That’s because the standard EEG typically uses 21 of them, affixed to the scalp in
strategic positions
to capture activity from various brain regions.
However, a team of researchers from Pennsylvania State University (Penn State) has ushered in the future of EEG, developing a single electrode that looks just like a strand of hair and is more reliable than the standard, multi-electrode version.
“This electrode allows for more consistent and reliable monitoring of EEG signals and can be worn without being noticeable, which enhances both functionality and patient comfort,” said
Tao Zhou
, a professor of engineering science and mechanics at Penn State and the study’s co-corresponding author.
Standard EEGs commonly use around 20 electrodes attached with conductive gel
Depositphotos
Used to record the brain’s electrical activity, an EEG is important for diagnosing and monitoring neurological conditions such as epilepsy, seizures,
sleep disorders
, and brain damage. The rigidity of the electrodes used in current EEGs means that even slight movement introduces noise and artifacts into the recording and limits the ability of patients to move freely. Commonly, “wet electrodes” are used, which require the application of conductive gel to maintain proper contact with the scalp. That approach is messy (think gel in the hair), and because the gel tends to dry out over time, it must be reapplied to maintain signal quality.
“This will change the impedance – or interface – between the electrodes and the scalp and it can affect the brain signal that’s recorded,” Zhou said. “We also don’t always apply the electrodes in the exact same position either because we’re human. But if you change the position, even a little bit, the brain signals you’re monitoring can be different.”
With these downsides in mind, Penn State researchers developed their gel-less “stick-and-play” device for EEG monitoring. It’s designed to be worn continuously for long periods while not interfering with the wearer’s usual activities or drawing attention to its presence. To that end, the electrode portion of the device is 3D-printed using a polymer hydrogel to be 300 μm wide. It looks like a single strand of hair. (By the way, it can be printed using different biocompatible dyes to ensure the device matches the hair color of the wearer.) The electrode is attached to the scalp using a 3D-printable bioadhesive that, on testing, was found to be almost double the strength of commercial EEG gel. It stayed on after showering and exercise-induced sweating, but did not cause damage to the skin when it was removed.
The researchers tested the device’s long-term adhesion and electrical performance and compared it to the current, standard EEG using multiple electrodes. Even while human test subjects performed their regular activities, the electrode remained securely attached to the scalp for 24 hours. Impedance remained stable with no noticeable increase after 12 or 24 hours, meaning that the quality of the brain activity signal didn’t change. The hairlike device maintained better skin contact than the regular gel-dependent approach and eliminated motion artifacts.
The hairlike electrode (on the left) compared with an actual human hair (right)
Zhou Lab/Penn State
CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
(original image extended using generative AI)
“You don’t have to worry if the position of the electrode has changed or if the impedance has changed because the electrodes haven’t moved,” said Zhou.
Currently, the hairlike EEG device is wired, so patients must be connected to a machine while their brain activity is recorded. However, the researchers hope to develop a wireless version and foresee many applications for the device.

data.title: Vagus Nerve Stimulation Erases PTSD: Study
data.author: rmason
data.article_summary: 一项开创性临床研究发现，将迷走神经刺激（VNS）与传统疗法结合，可在治疗后六个月内使所有参与者的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）诊断消除。该试验将 prolonged exposure therapy 与通过植入设备进行的短时VNS结合，增强了神经可塑性并维持缓解状态。此前研究表明，许多PTSD患者对标准治疗无反应，因此这一方法尤为有前景。后续试验将进一步探索该疗法，旨在为对传统方法无效的患者提供新希望。这项由德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校开展的研究结果发表在《Brain Stimulation》上，下一步将进行双盲二期试验以确认结果并争取FDA批准。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）及其不同治疗方法的讨论，包括临床实验、技术设备和心理疗法。

不同观点：
• [pizza] 支持一种叫做创伤释放练习（Trauma Releasing Exercise, TRE）的方法，认为通过极端的肌肉疲劳和颤抖可能会帮助“重置”身体的状态，缓解紧张。他引用了一个假设，即成年人学会抑制可见的创伤反应，而儿童和动物不会，这可能使他们更快恢复正常。

• [nativeit] 认为文章标题具有误导性，因为实验样本量小且处于早期阶段，标题过于武断，属于不负责任的点击诱饵。尽管如此，结果仍然具有前景。

• [0xWTF] 提供了实际的PubMed链接，供人们查看实验的摘要，增加讨论的科学依据。

• [ccppurcell] 强调实验样本量仅为9人，认为标题中的确定性近乎不负责任。

• [PaulHoule] 提到长期以来的推测，即抑制生理反应可能会提高PTSD治疗的效果，并提供了一个相关文献链接。

• [elcritch] 和 [matthew_morgan] 对颈部支架式的迷走神经刺激器（vagus nerve stimulators）表示好奇，询问他人是否有使用经验。

• [binarymax] 提到一个朋友的创业公司正在开发消费级的VNS设备，并提供了一个相关链接。

• [emremremr] 更熟悉通过经验丰富的治疗师使用眼动脱敏再处理（EMDR）治疗PTSD，认为需要有经验的治疗师指导，以避免触发危险。

• [amelius] 提出为何不使用EMDR，并提供了一个维基百科链接。

• [ivape] 对通过技术手段消除情感体验持怀疑态度，认为PTSD患者需要面对和消化过去的创伤，而不是简单地通过技术手段抹去情感记忆。

补充讨论：
• 对小型实验的样本量和实验结果的确定性存在争议，特别是标题是否夸大其词。
• 对不同治疗方法的有效性和可行性存在不同看法，如TRE、EMDR和VNS设备。
• 对技术干预（如VNS设备）在心理创伤治疗中的伦理和哲学反思。

总体来看，讨论围绕PTSD治疗方法的多样性和科学性展开，涉及临床实验的有效性、技术设备的实用性和心理干预的伦理问题。

43919812.article_content:
Summary:
A pioneering clinical study found that pairing vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) with traditional therapy eliminated PTSD diagnoses in all participants up to six months post-treatment. The trial combined prolonged exposure therapy with brief bursts of VNS via an implanted device, enhancing neuroplasticity and sustaining remission.
Prior research shows many PTSD patients fail to respond to standard treatments, making this approach especially promising. Future trials will explore the therapy further, aiming to offer new hope for those resistant to conventional methods.
Key Facts:
100% Remission:
All participants were free from PTSD diagnosis six months after therapy paired with VNS.
Neuroplasticity Boost:
VNS enhances brain rewiring, improving outcomes for therapy-resistant PTSD patients.
Next Steps:
A double-blind Phase 2 trial is underway to confirm findings and move toward FDA approval.
Source:
UT Dallas
In a first-of-its-kind clinical study, scientists at The University of Texas at Dallas and Baylor University Medical Center showed that patients with treatment-resistant PTSD were symptom-free up to six months after completing traditional therapy paired with vagus nerve stimulation (VNS).
The results of the nine-patient Phase 1 trial, conducted by scientists from UT Dallas’ Texas Biomedical Device Center (TxBDC) in collaboration with researchers from the Baylor Scott & White Research Institute (BSWRI), were published online March 15 in Brain Stimulation.
Credit:
Neuroscience News
Dr. Michael Kilgard, the Margaret Fonde Jonsson Professor of neuroscience in the School of Behavioral and Brain Sciences, said the outcome highlighted the potential of this approach.
“In a trial like this, some subjects usually do get better, but rarely do they lose their PTSD diagnosis. Typically, the majority will have this diagnosis for the rest of their lives,” Kilgard said. “In this case, we had 100% loss of diagnosis. It’s very promising.”
Prolonged exposure therapy — a component of traditional PTSD treatment — is a form of cognitive behavioral therapy, conducted in a safe and supportive environment, that involves individuals gradually confronting thoughts, memories and situations they have avoided since experiencing a trauma.
In the study, scientists paired this therapy with concurrent delivery of short bursts of stimulation of the vagus nerve via a small device implanted in a participant’s neck.
After a standard 12-session therapy course, assessments were performed four times during the six months after its conclusion. Benefits persisted during that time for all nine participants.
The study is the largest clinical trial to date using an implanted device for the treatment of PTSD, Kilgard said.
Pioneering work by TxBDC researchers has demonstrated previously that VNS paired with physical rehabilitation can accelerate neuroplasticity — the rewiring of areas of the brain.
Their 13-year effort to treat a wide variety of conditions using VNS has resulted in approval by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for treating impaired upper-limb movement in stroke patients.
“The common theme in our VNS work is that we’re taking therapies that show potential, like prolonged exposure therapy for PTSD, and making them work better,” he said.
The National Center for PTSD, part of the Department of Veterans Affairs, estimates that 5% of adults in the U.S. have post-traumatic stress disorder in any given year, and that women are twice as likely to develop PTSD at some point in their life.
Many PTSD patients fail to respond to therapy or pharmacological intervention, or experience intolerable side effects or relapse, leaving them with no viable prospect for remission.
Kilgard said that PTSD patients are not only found among military veterans, but also among average citizens who have faced traumatic events.
“When you hear PTSD, you may picture a combat zone, but it’s much more prevalent than that,” he said.
“It can stem from any event that inspires fear of death or bodily injury, or death of a loved one.”
Co-corresponding author Dr. Seth Hays, associate professor of bioengineering in the Erik Jonsson School of Engineering and Computer Science and director of preclinical research at the TxBDC, has been a part of the VNS project since its earliest studies.
“It’s been an incredibly rewarding experience to see this technology evolve from early discovery experiments in the lab to clinical benefits in patients,” Hays said. “This whole process truly highlights the value of team-based science.”
More than a decade ago, Dr. Robert Rennaker, professor of neuroscience and the Texas Instruments Distinguished Chair in Bioengineering, began to design an innovative implantable VNS device that was much smaller and less expensive than devices already on the market. The most recent wireless version of the device is about the size of a dime.

• [binarymax] 提到一个朋友的创业公司正在开发消费级的VNS设备，并提供了一个相关链接。

• [emremremr] 更熟悉通过经验丰富的治疗师使用眼动脱敏再处理（EMDR）治疗PTSD，认为需要有经验的治疗师指导，以避免触发危险。

• [amelius] 提出为何不使用EMDR，并提供了一个维基百科链接。

• [ivape] 对通过技术手段消除情感体验持怀疑态度，认为PTSD患者需要面对和消化过去的创伤，而不是简单地通过技术手段抹去情感记忆。

补充讨论：
• 对小型实验的样本量和实验结果的确定性存在争议，特别是标题是否夸大其词。
• 对不同治疗方法的有效性和可行性存在不同看法，如TRE、EMDR和VNS设备。
• 对技术干预（如VNS设备）在心理创伤治疗中的伦理和哲学反思。

总体来看，讨论围绕PTSD治疗方法的多样性和科学性展开，涉及临床实验的有效性、技术设备的实用性和心理干预的伦理问题。

data.title: RSC for Astro Developers
data.author: feross
data.article_summary:
本文简要介绍了Astro框架中的组件机制和React Server Components（RSC）的相似之处。Astro组件（.astro文件）运行于服务器端，能执行如读取文件系统或数据库等操作，但无法实现交互功能。交互部分由客户端岛屿（Client Islands）处理，这些岛屿可以使用React、Vue等前端框架实现交互。Astro组件与客户端岛屿生活在两个不同的“世界”中，数据只能从Astro组件传递到客户端岛屿。

React Server Components（RSC）采用了类似的模型，分为服务器组件和客户端组件。服务器组件负责预处理，客户端组件处理交互。RSC使用'use client'指令来区分这两个世界，而Astro通过.astro文件和客户端岛屿的不同语法实现分离。

两者的核心思想非常相似，熟悉Astro的开发者可以很快上手RSC。某些不依赖客户端或服务器特性的组件可以在两者中通用，例如纯函数式的Markdown组件。RSC中从服务器世界导入的组件将在服务器端运行。

data.title: Proposal: Add bare metal support to Go
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: 该提案建议在Go语言中增加对无操作系统（"bare metal"）环境的支持，通过引入新的GOOS目标`GOOS=none`，使Go程序能够在没有底层操作系统的情况下运行。这依赖于Go运行时和外部驱动包提供的支持，而不是依赖操作系统调用。该功能已经在`GOOS=tamago`项目中实现，并提议纳入上游。主要改动包括定义一系列用于硬件初始化、随机数生成、系统时间获取、内存布局等功能的特定函数，如`cpuinit`、`runtime.hwinit`、`runtime.printk`等。编译此类目标的方式与标准Go二进制文件相同，但加载策略可能因硬件而异。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于新提案中将Go应用运行在没有内核的极简环境中的讨论，以及对性能和应用场景的分析。

不同观点：
• [jasonthorsness] 认为当前已经在使用“scratch”容器来减少安全漏洞的风险，而该提案则是将这一思路推向极致，甚至取消了内核。他对该提案表示出强烈兴趣，并提出问题，如这种方案能否在云虚拟机上运行，以及镜像可以缩小到多小。

• [Someone] 关注提案中的技术细节，特别是对打印函数`printk`的实现提出质疑。他认为，打印“Hello, world!”需要进行13次函数调用是不够高效的，建议应该有一个能够处理字节数组的`printk`函数以提高性能。同时，他对比了随机数据生成函数`getRandomData`，认为其单次调用处理数组的方式更加高效。

• [rcarmo] 提到已经在使用TinyGo，并且认为TinyGo已经很好地完成了类似的工作。他质疑将此类功能纳入主线是否必要。

• [advanderveer] 对提案的潜在应用表示兴趣，特别是如果它能够为Go语言实现确定性模拟测试。他指出过去在这方面的努力效果不佳，因此对新提案抱有期待。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的技术细节包括打印函数的效率问题以及随机数据生成函数的实现方式，反映出开发者对性能优化的关注。
• 不同的观点还涉及到该提案是否应该被纳入主线开发，以及其在实际应用场景（如云计算和测试）中的可行性和潜在价值。
• 安全性和资源占用也是讨论的重要方面，特别是在容器化和微服务架构中，减少用户空间组件被认为是减少安全漏洞的有效手段。

data.title: Protein-slayer drugs could beat some of the cruellest cancers
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了利用PROTACs（蛋白降解靶向嵌合体）这一新型药物策略来对抗儿童癌症，如神经母细胞瘤。传统药物通常通过阻断蛋白质功能起作用，而PROTACs则通过引导细胞的蛋白降解机制彻底清除致病蛋白质。由于许多致病蛋白质被认为是“不可药用的”，PROTACs为开发新疗法提供了可能。儿科肿瘤学家Yael Mossé正领导团队开发针对这些“不可药用”蛋白质的PROTACs，特别是针对神经母细胞瘤和其他儿童实体瘤。尽管该技术早期被质疑，但目前已有30多种PROTACs进入临床试验，针对乳腺癌、前列腺癌、白血病等。Mossé团队预计其首批PROTACs将在未来几年进入临床试验，这可能为治疗残酷的儿童癌症开辟新途径。

How protein-slayer drugs could beat some of the cruellest cancers
Download PDF
Twitter
Facebook
Email
Illustration: Agnes Jonas
You have full access to this article via your institution.
Download PDF
At three years old, Evan Lindberg was diagnosed with neuroblastoma, a childhood cancer that develops in nerve tissue outside the brain. By that time, tumours had spread through his small body. Chemotherapy, radiation,
immunotherapy
and multiple surgeries followed. “For four years, my son never had a day off,” says Evan’s father, Gavin. “He was either in treatment or recovery. And frequently recovery was worse than the treatment.” Evan died in 2010 at the age of seven.
One of Evan’s doctors, paediatric oncologist Yael Mossé at the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, has long sought improved treatment options. She has worked on neuroblastoma for more than two decades, yet despite small advances, “we really have made very little progress in developing more rational or targeted therapies”, she says. That’s true in general for childhood solid tumours. Although such tumours are less common than
blood cancers in children
, they account for more than half of cancer-associated deaths in kids aged 0–14 years
1
in the United States. These childhood cancers differ from adult ones in their biology, and thus require distinct treatments. Yet out of more than 180 cancer drugs that have received approval from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) since 2000, fewer than a dozen have been developed specifically for children.
‘Dark proteins’ hiding in our cells could hold clues to cancer and other diseases
Mossé is now placing her hopes on laboratory-made molecules that
hijack the cell’s protein-disposal machinery
. Typical drugs gum up the business end of a protein to inhibit its activity. PROTACs, short for proteolysis-targeting chimeras, eliminate the protein altogether. They do this by tethering disease-associated proteins in human cells to an enzyme that tags the protein for destruction.
Enabling these fateful encounters — which biochemist Alessio Ciulli at the University of Dundee, UK, calls a protein “kiss of death” — expands the list of possible drug targets. Of the roughly 3,000 proteins known to cause cancer and other diseases, drugs approved by the FDA, for example, target fewer than 700. Most of the rest are considered ‘undruggable’, because there’s no suitable pocket in which a drug can attach and block the protein’s activity. But a PROTAC merely has to grab on; the cell’s existing machinery does the rest.
At least 30 PROTACs have entered clinical trials since 2019, when testing in humans began, mainly for cancer, but also for Parkinson’s disease, inflammatory disorders and
pain
. The three most advanced, for
breast cancer
, prostate cancer and leukaemia, are in phase III trials, the last step before market approval. Most degrade proteins that are targeted by already approved drugs.
Evan Lindberg, pictured on the left with his father Gavin, died of cancer at age seven. Gavin is now a patient advocate, working with paediatric oncologist Yael Mossé (right) and others to develop treatments for childhood cancers.
Credits: Wendy Lindberg, Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia
Mossé and her colleagues are doing something different — and riskier — by going after cancer proteins that have never been drugged before. She co-leads a team that is developing PROTACs against undruggable proteins responsible for neuroblastoma and other childhood cancers, including those of the brain, liver and bone. All of the cancers form solid tumours. Mossé expects the team’s first PROTACs to enter clinical trials in the next couple of years.
Other researchers are similarly aiming to degrade proteins that have long been considered untouchable, in cancer and beyond. “Showing that you can target something brand new with this technology will be a pivotal moment for the field,” says chemist Nathanael Gray at Stanford University in California, co-founder of C4 Therapeutics, a protein-degradation drug company in Watertown, Massachusetts.
More than a lab trick
The first working PROTAC was demonstrated in 2001, when Craig Crews, a chemical biologist at Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut, biochemist Raymond Deshaies, at the California Institute of Technology in Pasadena, and their colleagues constructed one that degraded its target protein in cell fluid from frog eggs
2
. At the time, most scientists viewed PROTACs as a lab trick. When Ciulli started working with them in 2009, colleagues “rolled their eyes”, he recalls. “They said, ‘PROTACs? They’ll never be drugs.’”
One early hurdle was making PROTACs small enough to penetrate cells. Another was designing them to grab onto the most abundant and efficient of the enzymes known as ubiquitin ligases. These enzymes, of which there are about 600 kinds, tag proteins for destruction by attaching chains of much smaller proteins called ubiquitins (see ‘Protein eliminated’). After a large ef

data.title: Hunting down a C memory leak in a Go program (2021)
data.author: fanf2
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了在Go程序中追踪C语言部分内存泄漏的过程，主要使用指标分析和eBPF等工具。作者所在团队使用Go和Kafka构建应用，并选择基于C库的`confluent-kafka-go`库。然而，在部署高流量Kafka消费者后，发现内存持续增长，疑似内存泄漏。通过分析Go的`memstats`和操作系统的RSS值，确认泄漏来自C部分而非Go。为确认问题，团队引入`jemalloc`获取更细致的内存分配指标，发现确实存在内存泄漏。使用Valgrind工具分析后，未找到明显泄漏点，推测可能是`mmap`等底层调用导致的问题。最终，通过eBPF工具进一步分析，定位了问题根源。
